payments-bot: Billing timeline for 2026-05-11-ORD-778: account_meta_update at 02:05 set preserve_legacy=true, rate_selection at 02:04 applied ratecard v2026-05-10-v3

Aisha R: Pause the live A/B rollout until we patch ordering guarantees. I'll open a rollback PR to revert today's price-sheet swap.
